title: Two classes, equal priors: the boundary at 13
caption: With equal priors and the same σ = 2 the densities cross halfway between the means 10 and 16, at x = 13. Classify to the nearer mean.
alt: Two normal curves with SD 2 centred at 10 and 16 crossing at x = 13, with a dashed line there.
description: The class densities are N(10, 2²) and N(16, 2²).
They are equal at the midpoint 13.
Left of 13 choose class 1, right of 13 class 2.

checks.name: the two densities cross at x = 13
